mistakeLabels.rushed: I rushed or ran out of time

notices.labelsSaved: Labels saved. They are private and do not change your result.
notices.nothingToRetry: There was nothing to retry: those questions are under review, or they were not ones you missed.
notices.rateLimited: Too many sessions were started in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.
notices.insufficientContent: Not enough new questions are left for that session. The options on this page show what is available now.
notices.notAMistake: Only a question you got wrong or left blank can be labelled.
notices.notFound: That question is not in one of your finished sessions.

page.title: Your results
page.expiredTitle: This session ran out of time
page.expiredBody: The clock reached zero, so unanswered questions were recorded as left blank.
page.retryTitle: A retry of questions you had missed
page.retryBody: These questions were asked again. This result stands on its own: it did not change the session the questions came from, and it is not counted in your accuracy by topic.
page.offerBody: That was your free diagnostic. A plan opens every {exam} practice format with fresh questions each time, brings back the questions you missed, and plans your sessions toward your test date.

error.title: Your results
error.alertTitle: These results could not be loaded
error.body: Something went wrong while reading this session. Try again in a moment.

verdict.heading: Outcome
verdict.accuracyTerm: Accuracy on the questions you answered
verdict.pointsTerm: Raw points, with this exam’s penalties
verdict.seenBefore: {seen} of these {total} questions you had been shown in an earlier session.

lost.heading: Where you lost marks
lost.intro: A topic needs at least {min} questions in a session before its accuracy says much. Below that you see the count, not a judgement. Your dashboard combines every session.
lost.nothing: Nothing: every question you were asked was answered correctly.
lost.needsAttention: Needs attention: {accuracy, number, percent} correct across {scored, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}}
lost.accuracy: {accuracy, number, percent} correct across {scored, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}}

next.heading: What to do next
next.understandBody: Each question opens on its own page with your answer, the correct one and the worked explanation.
next.retryBody: A retry is a separate session of repeated questions. It never changes this result, and it is not counted in your accuracy by topic.
next.retryButton: {count, plural, one {Retry the question you missed} other {Retry the # questions you missed}}
next.retryUnavailable: {count, plural, one {# of the questions you missed is under review, so it is not offered again for now.} other {# of the questions you missed are under review, so they are not offered again for now.}}
next.practiseBasis: You missed {missed} of {scored, plural, one {# {skill} question} other {# {skill} questions}} in this session.
next.practiseNewMeaning: “New” means questions you have never been shown: the session is built only from them.
next.practiseSkillButton: {count, plural, one {# new {skill} question} other {# new {skill} questions}}
next.skillExhausted: You have been shown all {reviewed, plural, one {# reviewed {skill} question} other {# reviewed {skill} questions}}. Retry the ones you missed.
next.skillExhaustedTopic: You have been shown all {reviewed, plural, one {# reviewed {skill} question} other {# reviewed {skill} questions}}. Retry the ones you missed, or practise the wider topic.
next.skillUnseen: {unseen} of the {reviewed} reviewed {skill} questions are new to you.
next.skillUnseenTopic: {unseen} of the {reviewed} reviewed {skill} questions are new to you; {topicUnseen} across {topic}.

howToRead.heading: How to read this
howToRead.scale: The real exam reports {scale} from {min} to {max}.
howToRead.noPercentiles: We do not report percentiles. They require a calibrated reference population we do not have.
howToRead.noReadiness: This page makes no readiness or admission judgement.
howToRead.unverified: Rules we could not verify for this exam ({count})
howToRead.formatGuide: See the full format guide and sources

review.heading: Question {n} of {total}
review.correctedBody: It is shown here exactly as you saw it, and your result stands as it was. New practice and retries use the corrected version, which has passed review.
review.revisingBody: This question is shown as you saw it, but it is not offered for new practice or retries until its revision has been reviewed.
review.difficultyEditorial: Difficulty label: editorial judgement, not calibrated against response data.
review.difficultyEmpirical: Difficulty label: empirical judgement, not calibrated against response data.
review.tutorUpgrade: A deeper AI explanation of this question is part of All access.
review.labelsBody: Only you know, so nothing is filled in for you. Choose any that apply. Labels are private and change nothing about your result.
review.report: Report a problem with this question
review.noExpertReview: AI-assisted question, checked by a blind AI solve. No human expert review is recorded for it yet.
review.expertReviewOriginal: The reviewer approved the English original; this translation was checked separately.

answer.essayWritten: You wrote a response; it is kept with this session.
answer.essayKey: Essays are not scored automatically. Check what you wrote against the self-assessment guide in the explanation.

notebook.metaDescription: Questions you got wrong or left blank: what is due to revisit now, what comes back later, and why.
notebook.title: Mistake notebook
notebook.lead: A missed question comes back the day after, and again at growing intervals once you answer it correctly.

descriptions.due: Missed questions whose time to come back has arrived, oldest first.
descriptions.later: Missed questions scheduled to come back, soonest first. A miss returns the day after; you can revisit one early.
descriptions.all: Every question you have got wrong or left blank in a finished session, most recent first.
descriptions.bookmarked: Questions you bookmarked, whether you got them right or not.

notebook.retryBodyPaged: A retry asks the questions on this page again in a separate session. It never changes your earlier results and is not counted in your accuracy by topic; answering a question correctly moves it further out in the schedule.
notebook.retryBody: A retry asks these same questions in a separate session. It never changes your earlier results and is not counted in your accuracy by topic; answering a question correctly moves it further out in the schedule.
notebook.retryUnavailable: {count, plural, one {# of these is under review and not offered again for now.} other {# of these are under review and not offered again for now.}}
notebook.emptyDueLaterBody: {count, plural, one {# missed question comes back later.} other {# missed questions come back later.}}
notebook.emptyDueLaterBodyNext: {count, plural, one {# missed question comes back later, the next on {date}.} other {# missed questions come back later, the next on {date}.}}
notebook.emptyDueNone: When you miss a question in a finished session, it comes back here the day after.
notebook.emptyLaterBody: Questions you miss are scheduled to come back here.
notebook.emptyAllBody: Questions you get wrong or leave blank in a finished session appear here, with the answer and the full explanation.
notebook.emptyBookmarkedBody: Bookmark a question from its review page and it is kept here, whether you answered it correctly or not.
